subtests.name: Same-origin child realm Global can be imported in the parent realm
Constructed native numeric Global brand, reads and writes
Re-exported mutable Global retains identity across instances and mutation is live
Defined exports preserve aliases and distinct instances have distinct native globals
Synchronous JS callback may re-enter the same instance and read/write its Global
Nested callback can return through another store and back to the original
A start import may access an already-live Global and call an existing export
An immutable primitive import is wrapped once and refuses writes
Wrong global type or mutability rejects without changing the supplied Global
Nested host exception identity is retained and subsequent entries still work
Shared mutable i64 global keeps 64-bit browser and Wasm updates live
Duplicate wrappers observe the same Wasm storage independently of JS wrapper identity
Asynchronous compilation and byte/module instantiation preserve the supplied Global
